scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.passkey.config.ts --mode main-world && vite build --config vite.passkey.config.ts --mode isolated-world && node tools/build-firefox.mjs
scripts.test:end-to-end: npm run build && playwright test extension.spec inline-menu.spec one-time-code.spec passkey.spec passkey-policy.spec passkey-extensions.spec address.spec vault.spec unlock.spec card.spec identity.spec save.spec save-expiry.spec
